jobs.description:
**City Brewing Company – Who We Are**

With our roots in La Crosse, WI, we are proud to be North America’s largest co-packager of alcoholic beverages with four locations across the United States. Through our focuses on **Safety** throughout our facilities, **Quality** of products produced for our customers, **Communication** at all levels, **Growth** of not just our locations but also of our employees in their careers, and **Performance** with our ability to meet deadlines and goals for ourselves and our customers, we pride ourselves on the brand we have created and continue to grow.

**Job Summary**

The Software Engineer works with users and customers to envision, plan, design, code, test, document, implement and maintain purchased applications (such as Infios Supply Chain Software) and custom-developed desktop and web-based applications. The role supports reporting initiatives, application development, integrations, data management and AI-enabled automation, delivering technology results that create better operational, user and customer experience while enabling growth through simplicity.

The Software Engineer typically works independently on complex, medium- and large-scope (multi-brewery) projects, collaborates with the IT Applications team, and acts as a project leader who directs the work of others. This position will enable new applications, apply AI and agentic AI to streamline business processes, and enhance legacy applications.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**Development & Support**

* Develop and maintain applications, reports, interfaces and data collection processes.
* Use programming languages such as C#, PHP, .NET and JavaScript, including Object-Oriented Design, to develop, maintain and enhance applications for the business.
* Design/code/implement custom business applications and develop specifications.
* Design high-performance reports using SQL and understand complex data schemas to write efficient queries.
* Develop complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views and other database objects in Microsoft SQL Server.
* Design, develop and maintain SSIS ETL processes and manage SSRS production and test environments.
* Use standard coding techniques, source control and change control.
* Develop test plans and thoroughly test and debug all programs before implementation.
* Develop data auditing techniques with users to ensure data integrity.
* Work closely with the IT team and project managers to provide timeline and task information based on proposed project scopes.
* Actively participate in developing and maintaining IT Development standards, including coding and testing standards.
* May act as project leader and direct the work of others.

**Business Applications Support**

* Assist with software evaluation and make recommendations for acquisition and implementation.
* Evaluate, recommend and implement business application upgrades.
* Coordinate system bug, enhancement and upgrade requests with vendors and internal users, assisting with specification, testing and implementation.
* Work with users to develop proper business procedures, standard practices and documentation to support efficient use of business applications.
* Collaborate with business analysts and end users to understand project requirements and develop program specifications.

**AI & Agentic AI**

* Identify, evaluate and implement AI and generative AI solutions that improve operational efficiency, reporting and the user experience.
* Design, build and deploy agentic AI solutions, such as autonomous agents and multi-step workflows that use tools and APIs to complete business tasks.
* Integrate large language models (LLMs) and AI services into existing and new applications through APIs and integration frameworks such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Apply prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent orchestration techniques to build reliable, maintainable solutions.
* Establish guardrails, testing, monitoring and human-in-the-loop controls so AI outputs are accurate, secure and auditable.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to improve code quality, testing, documentation and delivery speed.
* Partner with business users to identify AI automation opportunities and train teams to use AI tools effectively.

**Communication**

* Communicate with other members of the digital team, end users, customers as necessary.
* Collaborate with business users, the Helpdesk and Technical Support Associates to troubleshoot problems.

**Project Standards & Procedures**

* Follow all City Brewing Standards and Systems Standards to develop and support projects.
* Provide input to IS Standards for modifications or changes.

**Production Issues**

* Identify and proactively resolve problem trends.
* Execute action plans for problem resolution following established processes.
* Troubleshoot questions and problems.
* Participate in the On Call Support rotation with other Applications team members.

**Security & Confidentiality**

* Maintain information security and confidentiality, reporting unauthorized incidents to management.
* Suggest and recommend ideas for systems and data security, including secure and responsible use of AI.
* Follow City Brewing values and perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or associate degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems or a related field or at least 5 years of related relevant experience
* ERP or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) applications experience preferred.
* 3-5 years of experience in programming languages including C#, PHP, .NET (.NET Core or similar) and JavaScript, with Object-Oriented Design.
* 3-5 years of experience with Microsoft T-SQL and Microsoft BI technologies (T-SQL, SSIS, SSRS, SSAS).
* Experience with Web APIs and REST-based communication.
* Experience in Agile development practices preferred.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Full-Stack ML Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------

Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into a formal representation, so every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved. Pramaana's architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4. Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts.

**The Role**
------------

We’re looking for a full-stack engineer with focus on infrastructure to build the tools and systems that help Pramaana’s engineers and researchers develop, test, deploy, and operate their work more effectively.

Your initial focus will be **DevOps and MLOps**: improving development environments and deployment workflows, making experiments and evaluations reproducible, and helping teams understand the behavior, performance, and cost of AI systems. You’ll build across interfaces, backend services, and infrastructure automation—not just maintain scripts or configure dashboards.

This is an early-stage role with scope across the company. As needs evolve, your work will extend into shared capabilities such as identity and access, LLM gateways, API-key management, training and inference platform maintenance, usage metering, and internal applications. You’ll work directly with the people using these systems, turning recurring friction into reliable, self-serve tools.

We’re looking for someone who treats internal tools as products: useful, understandable, well-maintained, and built around the workflows of the people who depend on them.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Improve how software gets built and deployed.** Develop repeatable local environments, automated tests, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment workflows. Help make configuration, secrets, releases, and rollbacks easier to manage safely.
* **Build tools for the AI development lifecycle.** Create workflows for running experiments and evaluations, versioning datasets and configurations, tracking results and artifacts, and deploying or integrating model services. Make runs easier to reproduce, compare, and investigate. Help researchers get from a recipe to a running job, and from a failed job to the cause..
* **Create full-stack, self-serve applications.** Build interfaces and APIs that let teams launch jobs, manage configurations, inspect results, and troubleshoot failures without relying on repeated manual assistance.
* **Make systems observable and costs understandable.** Connect logs, metrics, traces, and usage data so teams can diagnose issues, identify bottlenecks, and understand where time and compute are being spent.
* **Contribute to shared platform services.** Help build and integrate identity, access controls, LLM routing, API keys, budgets, and usage metering across Pramaana’s products and internal workflows.
* **Use existing tools thoughtfully.** Evaluate and extend open-source or managed solutions where they fit. Build custom software where it solves a real gap, rather than recreating infrastructure unnecessarily.
* **Improve tools through direct feedback.** Work alongside engineers and researchers to identify recurring problems, prioritize improvements, and measure whether tools reduce setup time, manual work, and failed runs. Maintain tests, documentation, and operational guidance for what you ship.

**You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have**
--------------------------------------------

* **Minimum 2-3 years of software engineering experience**, including hands-on work with backend services, full-stack applications, internal tools, or deployment automation.
* **A solid foundation in building software across the stack.** You can develop services and automation in Python or TypeScript, work with APIs and databases, and build usable interfaces with React or a similar framework.
* **Practical cloud and deployment experience.** You’ve deployed applications using containers and a cloud platform such as AWS, worked with CI/CD, and used logs or metrics to investigate problems.
* **Some hands-on exposure to AI or ML workflows.** This could include integrating model APIs, running evaluations, tracking experiments, or operating model-backed applications through work or substantial projects. You don’t need to be an ML researcher.
* **A product mindset for internal users.** You care about clear interfaces, sensible defaults, useful documentation, and reducing the number of steps it takes someone to get their work done.
* **Good engineering judgment and a collaborative approach.** You write maintainable code, test important behavior, ask for review, and communicate trade-offs. You can take ownership of a scoped problem while recognizing when to seek help.

**Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have**
----------------------------------------------

* Experience with experiment tracking, evaluation pipelines, workflow orchestration, or model observability using tools such as MLflow, Langfuse, or Temporal.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, container orchestration, or telemetry tooling, such as Terraform, Kubernetes, or OpenTelemetry.
* Experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes: job queueing and preemption multi-node training with NCCL over EFA or InfiniBand, GPU node health and driver management, or serving models with vLLM or SGLang.
* Experience implementing authentication, role-based access, API-key management, image provenance, LLM gateways, usage and cost tracking or hardening public endpoints.
* Experience adapting open-source software or building developer tools that other engineers or researchers use regularly.

jobs.title: Lead Systems Software Engineer - Object Storage
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities - Technical Leadership**

* Act as the technical lead for the Centennial object storage team while remaining substantially hands-on.

* Lead technical direction and drive key architectural decisions across the team's areas of ownership, including the data path, durability, S3, and data movement.

* Design and build critical components, lead design and code reviews, help engineers solve complex systems problems, and ensure appropriate automated testing and CI coverage for critical changes.

* Mentor engineers and develop technical ownership across the team.

* Partner with the Software Engineering Manager / Product Owner on scope, sequencing, technical risk, and delivery.

**Object Storage Data Path & S3**

* Design, implement, and optimize features in the ActiveScale data path, handling the flow from incoming S3 requests to durable storage across NVMe, HDD, and tape.

* Implement and extend the S3 API, ensuring correct protocol behavior and efficient request handling.

* Improve latency, throughput, scalability, and reliability of the I/O pipeline for exabyte-scale deployments using Linux profiling and systems debugging.

**Durability, Data Placement & Resilience**

* Own complex durability and data-placement work, including two-dimensional erasure coding, and ensure correctness under failures such as node loss, disk faults, partial writes, and network partitions.

* Analyze and optimize concurrency, throughput, and fault tolerance across the request and storage paths.

**Scalability & Data Movement**

* Design and improve systems that move and tier data from high-performance NVMe through HDD to the tape cold-storage tier (ActiveScale Cold Storage).

* Drive the evolution of internal APIs, services, and interfaces that support the data path and data mover.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software development experience using Go, Python, C, C++, or Rust (or equivalent systems-level expertise), with a willingness to learn additional languages.

* Strong experience with distributed systems and high-performance storage software design.

* Strong Linux experience, including systems programming, debugging, profiling, and performance analysis of complex systems.

* Solid understanding of concurrency, synchronization, locking, asynchronous programming, and memory management in performance-sensitive software.

* Understanding of cloud and enterprise storage concepts and the characteristics of storage media such as HDD, SSD, NVMe, and tape.

* Experience with object storage or S3-compatible APIs.

* Demonstrated technical leadership of a team or significant engineering workstream.

* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams, including collaboration with the established ActiveScale engineering teams in Belgium.

* This is a hybrid role, with in-office work at our Centennial, CO office Tuesday through Thursday.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with the Linux I/O subsystem and networking.

* Knowledge of erasure coding principles.

* Experience with storage protocols and clustering design and development.

* Experience with REST, gRPC, or Thrift.

* Experience with Amazon S3 APIs, SDKs, and tools.

* Familiarity with OCaml is welcome but not required; parts of the existing ActiveScale codebase are written in it.

We're The Bluebird Group - we're an omnichannel commerce partner that helps brands grow across every retail and digital channel.

We sit at the intersection of retail, eCommerce, media, and data. We help brands show up wherever their customers are (Target, Amazon, Walmart, Costco, Kroger, social commerce like TikTok, and beyond) and drive real sales growth.

We're not just strategists - we're a hands-on team of experienced retail operators who execute across everything from retail media and creative to data, insights, and full go-to-market strategy.

The result: we simplify what's become a really complex retail landscape and help brands scale faster and smarter.

**Job Summary**

We’re looking for a resourceful, ambitious builder excited to work at the intersection of retail analytics, data engineering, and technology enablement. This entry-level role (1–2 years of software or data engineering experience) is ideal for someone who loves data, enjoys solving problems, working with a driven team, and wants to help create the next generation of retail capabilities.

Foundational knowledge of software and data engineering is important, plus the grit to learn fast, navigate roadblocks, and take ownership of meaningful projects from day one. You’ll work closely with our retail pillar stakeholders to provide valuable solutions while also helping automate workflows, build data pipelines, and support new software tools.

Required:

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Construction
jobs.description:
*Every day, our team members do amazing things in pursuit of our shared purpose to build trust with our clients, partners, subcontractors, and teammates. No matter your background, education, or career path, if you share our vision to create extraordinary experiences, you belong* ***at HITT****.*

Robotics Software Engineer - Construction

**Job Description:**
====================

The Robotics Software Engineer is responsible for developing and deploying autonomous robotics solutions that must operate in some of the most challenging real-world environments. This role will own work across the development lifecycle: creating proof-of-concept prototypes, maturing promising concepts into feature-complete systems, and hardening those systems for reliable deployment on jobsites.

This team member reports to the Robotics Software Lead and is part of HITT’s Robotics Team, which leads research and development, pilot programs, and full-time field deployments. The Robotics Team’s mission is to support our project teams, transform our industry, and bring robots to every jobsite.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who has a deep system-level understanding of what it takes for robots to operate in unstructured environments, handle dynamic obstacles, safely work around people, and work reliably with limited networking and power infrastructure. Although they may specialize in autonomy, perception, or manipulation, they are comfortable contributing across the robotics stack and addressing issues that span software, sensors, compute, networking, and mechanical hardware. They can move quickly when building an early proof-of-concept while applying the engineering discipline needed to mature it into a field-ready solution.

We encourage strong candidates excited by this role to apply even if they do not match every technical qualification listed.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Robotics Software & Systems Integration

* Design, develop, integrate, and test software for complex field robotics applications.
* Support the development and maturation of the HITT robotics software stack.
* Integrate robot platforms, sensors, actuators, embedded computers, networks, and operator interfaces into cohesive systems.
* Develop field-ready autonomy capabilities, including localization, mapping, navigation, state estimation, and mission planning.
* Integrate perception pipelines using cameras, LiDAR, depth sensors, inertial sensors, and other sensing modalities.
* Develop manipulation applications involving motion planning, controls, end effectors, calibration, and task execution.
* Use simulation, synthetic data, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and repeatable test environments to accelerate development and reduce field risk.
* Configure and troubleshoot network connectivity on robots, sensors, operator interfaces, and cloud services using wired and wireless networks.
* Serve as a strong technical contributor across the stack while bringing depth in one or more of these areas; expertise in every discipline is not expected.

Collaboration & Partnerships

* Collaborate with software engineers, hardware engineers, field testing engineers, vendors, partners, end users, and other stakeholders.
* Integrate and extend third-party technologies using APIs, SDKs, middleware, and other software interfaces.
* Contribute to co-development efforts with vendors and technology partners to establish technical requirements, resolve integration challenges, and evaluate solutions.

Field Testing & Deployment

* Plan and execute structured testing in the lab, at test sites, and on active construction projects.
* Deploy alongside field teams, observe real workflows, collect data, diagnose issues, and convert field feedback into engineering priorities.
* Design for difficult real-world conditions, including dust, changing lighting, uneven terrain, vibration, intermittent connectivity, dynamic obstacles, and frequent environmental change.
* Support deployed systems through remote and on-site troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Document architectures, interfaces, test results, deployment procedures, and lessons learned so solutions can be supported and scaled.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in robotics, computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or 2+ years of experience in developing, integrating, and testing field robotics systems.
* Proficiency in C++, Python, and Linux-based robotics development.
* Proficiency in modern software-engineering practices, including version control (e.g., Git), automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker).
* Experience working with APIs/SDKs, open-source software packages, and technical standards to bring together disparate technology components into a reliable solution.
* Fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor).
* Strong system-level troubleshooting skills across software, hardware, networking, and field operations.
* Ability to work effectively in uncertain, fast-moving environments and take ownership of open-ended technical problems.
* Ability to effectively communicate complex technical topics in written and verbal formats to various audiences.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to prioritize tasks across multiple projects.
* Willingness to travel to active construction sites and participate directly in testing and deployment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience developing robotic systems for construction, manufacturing, logistics, agriculture, mining, defense, or other demanding real-world environments.
* Experience developing robotic systems using Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) or comparable robotics middleware.
* Experience in mobile robot perception, SLAM, and navigation for ground and/or aerial robots.
* Experience developing or integrating mobile manipulation systems,

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - SDK
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

The SDK team within AGS is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing both front and back-end features for use by our internal game studios, as well as leading and supporting company-wide initiatives to introduce the most modern technologies and frameworks into both internal and customer-facing products. Developers within SDK work both inside and outside of our game system’s primary codebase to create comprehensive solutions to new requirements and challenges faced by our engineering teams in bringing games to market. Our team places a high value on distribution of knowledge and skills throughout all members, as well as the flexibility to work alone, in groups, or with engineers outside our own team in order to identify and implement creative solutions in gameplay, engine, and platform systems.

**Responsibilities:**

* Software Engineer IIs on the SDK team are responsible for development of both Platform and Game Presentation features.
* You will be an active contributor in all aspects and stages of development, from participating in prototyping, requirements gathering and design, to implementation, documentation, deployment and maintenance.
* You will regularly act as a liaison between SDK team and Game Studios to communicate what the game platform can do, assist in solving technical challenges, and identify solutions to allow game requirements to work within the platform.
* Your knowledge and skills will be called upon to diagnose and implement optimizations or author coding or memory management strategies to improve game performance.
* You may be recruited to research or prototype new features or experimental changes to help improve the platform as a whole.
* This position requires a strong work ethic, a desire for continued self-improvement, and the willingness to engage with new or unfamiliar technologies or frameworks in search of the best solutions.
* It requires a commitment to being a positive contributor in both a group dynamic as well as independently, and to efficiently regulate workload within the team’s set objectives.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Data centers run on thousands of sensors, meters, and control systems, and the teams who run their power infrastructure have to make sense of all of it in real time. Teserac is building Neuron™, an AI-native observability and automation platform that gives those teams full visibility into their power operations and helps them get ahead of problems. At its core is an AI teammate that works alongside every operator around the clock: detecting anomalies, correlating events, and recommending what to do next.

As a Full Stack Developer, you'll own features end to end, from the ingestion path that pulls telemetry off a BMS in a live facility, through the time-series layer that stores it, to the dashboard an operator is watching at 2am.

This is a small team with real customers in production. Your code ships in days, not quarters, and it runs in facilities where being wrong has physical consequences. You'll work directly with the Principal Software & Architecture Lead, Product, and Solution Engineering. We move fast, avoid bureaucracy, and expect engineers to own outcomes rather than tickets.

This is a hybrid role based in our Santa Clara office, and visa sponsorship is available.

**Who We Are Looking For**

You're a full-stack engineer who is comfortable on both sides of the line, and who gets interested rather than annoyed when the data is messy, the vendor's API is undocumented, and the protocol spec is a PDF from 2009. You likely:

* Build front to back. You can trace a value from a Modbus register to a rendered chart without handing off, and you know where it's likely to break.
* Take databases seriously. You know that a query plan, an index, and a migration on a large table are engineering decisions, not configuration.
* Have worked with real time-series data at a volume where naive approaches stop working, and understand what that costs at read time and write time.
* Debug production calmly. When CPU is pinned and a queue is backing up, you reason from evidence rather than restarting things.
* Use AI tooling well. You get real leverage from Cursor, Claude Code, or similar, and your standards didn't drop when you started using it.

**What You'll Do**

**Product and front end**

* Build operator-facing features for Neuron™ in React and TypeScript: real-time dashboards, alerting, alarm and ticket workflows, capacity planning views, and power-flow visualizations.
* Build the interfaces the AI teammate works through: interaction panels, recommendation displays, approval workflows, and audit trails.
* Keep large, data-dense views fast and responsive across devices.

**Data ingestion and integrations**

* Build and maintain the ingestion path that brings telemetry from customer sites into Neuron™: edge collectors, MQTT over AWS IoT Core, queue-based workers, and normalization into a canonical metric model.
* Write integration modules against real building and power systems: Siemens Desigo, Schneider PME and EcoStruxure, Niagara, Eaton, and generic BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP sources.
* Own the correctness of what lands: point mapping, unit and phase semantics, deduplication, and backfill.

**Time-series platform**

* Develop against PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB: hypertables, continuous aggregates, compression, and retention.
* Design schema and migrations that stay safe as tables grow into the billions of rows.
* Find and fix the performance problems that only appear with real customer data volumes.

**Quality and operations**

* Write tested, reviewed code, and contribute to CI/CD and automated testing.
* Troubleshoot production issues across the stack, and share on-call as the platform scales.

**Why Teserac**

We're not building incremental improvements to legacy tools. We're re-architecting how data centers see, understand, and act on their own operations.

* Ship features that directly shape how some of the world's most critical AI infrastructure is powered and managed.
* Join a small engineering team where every developer has outsized impact and direct visibility into product decisions.
* Work where AI, real-time systems, and physical infrastructure meet.
* Grow with the company from Series A through scale.

  
**Requirements**  

* **Required**
* + 7+ years building and shipping production software across the stack
  + Strong Python, ideally Django. Our backend is Django and Celery, and it's the language you'll write most days.
  + Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, query performance, and migrations you'd run against a live production database
  + Practical time-series experience. TimescaleDB is ideal, and deep experience with another time-series or high-volume streaming store transfers.
  + Solid React and TypeScript, and the judgment to keep a data-heavy interface fast
  + Experience with asynchronous and event-driven systems: task queues, pub/sub, streaming, or WebSockets
  + Comfortable on AWS. We run ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, and IoT Core.
  + Able to work independently, define your own scope from a rough requirement, and ship
* **Preferred**
* + Industrial or IoT telemetry experience: BMS, EPMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar OT data sources
  + Hands-on experience with industrial protocols: BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, or vendor BMS APIs
  + Data center infrastructure familiarity: power distribution topology, UPS and PDU behavior, or PUE
  + Experience building observability or monitoring products, commercial or internal
  + Early-stage startup experience, Seed through Series B
* Nobody checks every box here. If some of these describe you, apply.

  
**Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
* Free Food & Snacks
* Stock Option Plan
* 401(k)

jobs.title: Forward-deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

GripFusion is building the next generation of sports performance technology with Tactile Intelligence. As our Forward-Deployed Software Engineer, you will expand every surface where GripFusion meets the athlete, from the ForceBall to the iPad, mobile, and web experiences that turn tactile data into decisions.

This is a product-facing engineering role reporting to Will Shawn, Head of Software. You will work across the full stack, spend time with players and coaches to understand how they use novel tactile data, and turn what you learn into shipped product. You will bring design and athlete thinking to every decision.

You will work alongside our product, embedded, data science, and design teams to build new visualizations, connect GripFusion to the systems our customers already use, and carry common design practices across our baseball and golf platforms.

**What You'll Build**
---------------------

* **The iPad app.** Extend and harden our primary product, built in React Native on an AWS backend and used by teams today.
* **The web dashboard.** Build a new React dashboard where coaches and staff review sessions, compare athletes, and share insights.
* **The mobile** **app.** Build a mobile app that communicates directly with the ForceBall and supports broader use cases at the field.
* **Novel visualizations.** Invent new ways to show tactile and athlete data, including 3D graphics that make the invisible obvious.
* **Integrations.** Pull in data from the other systems teams already use, so GripFusion fits naturally into their workflow.
* **The golf platform.** Contribute to our golf product and carry common design patterns and components across baseball and golf.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Work across the full stack, from BLE device communication and cloud services to mobile and web interfaces.
* Partner with players, coaches, and team staff to understand user needs and how they interact with tactile data.
* Balance quick prototyping and discovery with production-level engineering, testing, and deployment.
* Work with design to shape the user experience, and establish shared design practices across verticals.
* Partner with embedded and data science to define device data transmission, state handling, and data formats.
* Visit MLB teams to test with athletes and coaches, and bring product thinking back to the software stack.
* Use AI development tools every day, and help shape how the software team builds with them.

**Desired Skills & Qualifications**
-----------------------------------

* 4+ years shipping production software across mobile and web, ideally with React Native, React, and TypeScript.
* Full-stack experience, including cloud backends on AWS and the CI/CD and release pipelines that get apps to users.
* A track record of working directly with clients, users, or stakeholders to shape what gets built.
* Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools and agentic workflows.
* Experience with hardware systems, Bluetooth or other device data transmission, and device state diagrams (preferred).
* Offline-first mobile architecture and on-device data analysis (preferred).
* Data visualization or 3D graphics on web or mobile, such as three.js, WebGL, or React Three Fiber (preferred).
* Experience integrating third-party data sources and APIs (preferred).
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **An owner.** You take product and technical ownership end to end, from first conversation to shipped feature.
* **A builder who explores.** You love quick prototypes and discovery, but you know when a prototype needs to become a product.
* **Product- and design-minded.** You care about how an experience feels, not just whether it works.
* **An athlete at heart.** You have competed or coached, and you understand how players train, compete, and take feedback.
* **A great communicator.** You are as comfortable in a clubhouse with players and coaches as you are in a code review.
* **AI-first.** You embrace AI tools as a core part of how you design, build, and ship.

**Impact & Growth**
-------------------

This role is designed to grow with the company. You will shape how GripFusion shows up for athletes and coaches across every surface we build. As our baseball and golf platforms expand, you will have a seat at the table on product direction, design practices, and how our AI-first engineering team works.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Base salary:** $110,000 to $145,000, commensurate with experience.
* **Equity:** 0.1% to 0.25%.
* **Benefits:** Healthcare, dental, vision, and retirement matching.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

* Full-time, in-person role based at GripFusion's Performance Lab headquarters in Ann Arbor, MI, including our in-house pitching lab, with up to 10% travel to MLB/NCAA teams and partners.
* Collaborative, innovation-first startup environment working across hardware, firmware, software, design, and data science.
* Direct access to leadership and the opportunity to build a new category of sports performance technology from the ground up.
* Career development opportunities and professional growth.
* Family first, with a close-knit team that enjoys solving hard problems.

**Full Stack Software Engineer**

Artly AI | Seattle, WA | Full-time | In person

Artly AI builds robots and the software that makes them useful in the real world. We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer who can independently build, ship, and operate reliable software—and who has clear evidence of using AI development tools to deliver substantial production systems.

You will work across the stack on applications, services, data workflows, and tools that support our products and operations. **What you will do**

* Own features and systems from requirements and architecture through implementation, release, monitoring, and iteration.
* Build web applications, APIs, backend services, data workflows, integrations, and internal tools.
* Develop software that helps our team and operators manage real-world robotic systems and operations.

* Review generated changes and validate correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Improve tests, CI/CD, observability, deployment and rollback procedures, reusable components, and documentation.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong professional software development experience, typically five or more years, or equivalent evidence of exceptional independent delivery.
* Meaningful ownership of software used in production, including responsibility after launch.
* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript skills and experience building frontend applications with React.
* Strong backend development skills in Java and Spring Boot, including APIs, databases, authentication/authorization, integrations, and failure handling.
* Practical experience with automated tests, code review, cloud deployment, monitoring, and production debugging.

**Useful additional experience**

Robotics, IoT, telemetry, device management, 3D simulation, data pipelines, AI/ML tooling, distributed systems, infrastructure automation, or broad product ownership in a small team.

**Compensation and benefits**

* Annual base salary: $110,000–$170,000.
* Stock options.
* 20 paid vacation days per year.
* 10 paid holidays per year.
* Separate paid sick leave.
* Medical, dental and vision coverage.

**How to apply**

Submit your résumé and a short description of one substantial production system you shipped using AI development tools. Explain what it does, how it is used, the components and decisions you personally owned, how you used AI, how you verified the code, and one concrete outcome.

Links to a product, public repository, portfolio, or technical write-up are welcome. A sanitized description is sufficient for confidential work; please do not share proprietary code or sensitive employer information.

We value demonstrated contribution, engineering judgment, and reliable delivery. We do not evaluate AI proficiency by lines of generated code or by the percentage of code written by a tool.

This is a full-time, in-person position in Seattle, Washington. Learn more about Artly AI: https://artly.ai

Pay: $110,000.00 - $170,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid holidays
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Describe one substantial production system you personally shipped using AI development tools. What did you own, how was it used, what did AI contribute, how did you validate the code, and what evidence shows the outcome? A sanitized example is sufficient; do not share proprietary code or sensitive information.
* Describe an AI-generated defect or difficult production failure you personally diagnosed. How did you identify the cause, validate the fix, and prevent recurrence? Explain your own contribution and the tradeoffs you considered.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Software Engineer: Networking & Hardware-in-the-Loop**
========================================================

First Order Effects · Austin, TX

**Who We Are**
--------------

First Order Effects (FOE) is building America's Infrastructure Prime for the robotic era. Autonomous ships, drones, and robots are rewriting how the world moves, fights, and builds - but none of them work without infrastructure to power them, connect them, and launch and recover them. That's what we build.

**We've Built Cutting Edge Systems at Legendary Companies**
-----------------------------------------------------------

Our team comes from SpaceX, Anduril, Saronic, Lockheed Skunk Works, Forterra, and Fuse Energy. Before founding FOE, we built satellite ground stations that closed a national comms gap in days, deployed multi-megawatt power systems at commercial speed, and shipped autonomous surface vessels into Navy fleet production. We've built infrastructure at lightspeed before - now we're applying that playbook to an entire company.

**The Role**
------------

* Own the network inside Surge Hub, our rapidly deployable power system. Take today's early design and turn it into a secure, production-ready architecture.
* Segment traffic so control traffic stays isolated, while the devices that need internet connectivity get a clean, secure path out.
* Build for uptime: backup WAN, failover, and a network that holds when a link drops in the field.
* Design with security in mind from the first switch, not as a retrofit.
* Own the hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) test network in our Austin warehouse. Bring every Surge Hub component onto one test network and drive it with your code.
* Write portable test and automation software for Surge Hub and its test equipment, and integrate it with the product's C/C++ firmware and software.
* Build it from the ground up. You pick the equipment, set the architecture, and own the result.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design, build, and own HITL test systems: rack the hardware, connect it, and make software test it for real.
* Configure and maintain real networks, including switches, routers, VLANs, subnets, and firewalls, on hardware that ships.
* Live in Linux day to day.
* Write automation and test code in Python.
* Take projects from idea to outcome without waiting for a spec. Two or more years doing this on hardware products counts for more than a long resume of adjacent work.
* Bring a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or the shipped work that proves the same.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Network security depth: segmentation, hardening, firewall policy, and secure remote access.
* C and C++. Surge Hub firmware and software are written in them.
* A background in hardware or embedded products: power, aerospace, automotive, robotics, or defense. The domain matters less than the hardware.
* Startup experience, or time at a hard-tech company where you owned more than your title said.

**Compensation**
----------------

$140,000–$200,000 base + equity + benefits.

**ITAR requirement**
--------------------

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations (ITAR/EAR), applicants must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance; active clearance not required.

jobs.title: Systems Software Engineer - Object Storage
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**Object Storage Data Path & S3**

* Contribute to features in the ActiveScale data path, helping handle the flow from incoming S3 requests to durable storage across NVMe, HDD, and tape.

* Contribute to the implementation and extension of the S3 API, ensuring correct protocol behavior and efficient request handling.

* Analyze and help improve the latency, throughput, and reliability of the I/O pipeline, developing your Linux profiling and systems-debugging skills as you go.

**Durability, Data Placement & Resilience**

* Contribute to durability and data-placement work, including erasure coding, and help ensure correctness under failures such as node loss, disk faults, and partial writes.

* Help analyze and improve concurrency and throughput across the request and storage paths.

**Scalability & Data Movement**

* Contribute to the systems that move and tier data from high-performance NVMe through HDD to the tape cold-storage tier (ActiveScale Cold Storage).

**Engineering**

* Write clean, well-tested code with unit, component, and integration tests, use CI, take part in design discussions and code reviews, and grow toward independent ownership of components under the guidance of senior engineers.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 5 years of software development experience using Go, Python, C, C++, or Rust (or equivalent systems-level fundamentals), with a willingness to learn additional languages.

* Hands-on software development experience with concurrent, networked, distributed, or systems-level software.

* Solid Linux fundamentals, including basic debugging and performance analysis, with a willingness to develop deeper profiling and systems-debugging skills.

* Understanding of the basics of concurrency, locking, asynchronous programming, and memory management.

* Understanding of cloud or enterprise storage concepts and familiarity with storage technologies such as HDD, SSD, and NVMe, with an interest in learning about multi-tier storage systems.

* Good communication skills; ability to work in a team environment and with remote colleagues.

* Self-motivated and eager to learn, with a creative problem-solving mindset.

* This is a hybrid role, with in-office work at our Centennial, CO office Tuesday through Thursday.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with the Linux I/O subsystem and networking.

* Knowledge of erasure coding principles.

* Experience with object storage.

* Experience with storage protocols and with clustering design and development.

* Experience with APIs and communication protocols such as REST, gRPC, or Thrift.

* Familiarity with OCaml is welcome but not required; parts of the existing ActiveScale codebase are written in it.

* Experience with the Amazon S3 API, SDKs, and tools.

Description:

You will develop the guidance and control software that carries a flight vehicle from ascent through atmospheric entry and an autonomous runway landing. Your algorithms and C++ code will be exercised in high-fidelity simulation, hardware-in-the-loop environments, and ultimately in flight. You will help maintain the six-degree-of-freedom simulation that the broader program depends on for design decisions and mission confidence. If you value simple, testable software and want your work connected directly to vehicle performance, this role offers meaningful end-to-end ownership.

**WORKSITE**: Onsite in Titusville, Florida

**WORK SCHEDULE:** Full-time; schedule based on program needs

**PAY RATE:** Salary determined based upon experience

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

Paid sick leave based on state regulations after 90 days of employment

Medical, dental, and vision coverage after a waiting period (60% paid by Fortuna)

Free TeleMedicine and Mental Health support for all employees and their families.

Additional voluntary benefits: Group Life Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Critical Care, Short-Term Disability

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

Develop, integrate, test, and maintain flight GNC algorithms in C++ for ascent, entry, terminal-area energy management, approach, and autonomous landing.

Build and maintain a high-fidelity six-degree-of-freedom vehicle simulation used for algorithm development, verification, and program decision-making.

Model vehicle dynamics, sensors, actuators, atmosphere, navigation inputs, and failure cases with appropriate fidelity for each phase of flight.

Design and execute software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop tests, analyze results, and resolve discrepancies between models, hardware, and expected performance.

Collaborate with flight software, avionics, aerodynamics, propulsion, systems, test, and operations teams to define interfaces and verify integrated behavior.

Support mission rehearsals, flight-readiness activities, console operations, and post-flight data review for test and flight events.

Requirements:

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

At least five years of experience in guidance, navigation and control, flight controls, vehicle dynamics, robotics controls, or flight-critical embedded software.

Strong C++ development skills and a solid foundation in control theory, numerical methods, rigid-body dynamics, and state-space modeling.

Experience developing or maintaining six-degree-of-freedom simulations and validating algorithms through software-in-the-loop or hardware-in-the-loop testing.

Experience with flight-critical software, autonomous vehicles, launch vehicles, reentry vehicles, missiles, aircraft, or spacecraft is strongly preferred.

Bachelor's degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, computer engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent directly relevant experience.

Ability to work onsite in Titusville, Florida, communicate technical results clearly, and develop straightforward, testable, maintainable code.

Agent development and orchestration

* Build single- and multi-agent applications with LangChain and LangGraph, including stateful graphs, supervisor/worker and hierarchical patterns, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Engineer robust agentic loops (plan, act, observe, reflect) with clear termination conditions, retry and self-correction logic, guardrails, and cost and latency budgets.
* Apply loop engineering to tune iteration depth, tool-call strategy, memory handling, and state persistence so agents behave predictably.
* Use LangSmith for tracing, debugging, prompt and dataset management, and automated evaluation; maintain regression suites for agent behavior.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

* Build and optimize Agentic RAG (agent-driven query planning and iterative retrieval), Adaptive RAG (routing by query complexity), Corrective and Self-RAG, GraphRAG (knowledge-graph retrieval and reasoning), and Cache-Augmented Generation with semantic caching.
* Design chunking, embedding, hybrid search, re-ranking, and query-rewriting strategies.
* Measure retrieval quality with faithfulness, context precision and recall, and answer relevance.

Ontologies, context, and skills

* Develop domain ontologies and knowledge graphs (OWL/RDF or property-graph models) that ground agent reasoning and power GraphRAG.
* Practice context engineering: decide how instructions, memory, retrieved knowledge, and tool results are assembled in the context window.
* Build reusable agent skills and tool libraries with clear interfaces, documentation, and versioning.

Interoperability protocols

* Build and integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients that expose enterprise data, APIs, and tools to agents securely.
* Implement Agent-to-Agent (A2A) patterns for agent discovery, capability negotiation, task delegation, and cross-vendor communication.

Engineering and delivery

* Write production-quality Python (TypeScript optional) with tests, CI/CD, and secure coding practices.
* Take agents from prototype to production with product, data, and platform teams.
* Contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, and internal standards for agentic systems.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10 years of software engineering, with at least 4 years building LLM-powered applications.
* Hands-on production experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith.
* Demonstrated experience designing agentic loops, tool calling, memory, and multi-agent orchestration.
* Practical experience implementing several RAG variants (Agentic, Adaptive, GraphRAG, Cache RAG/CAG) and evaluating their quality.
* Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs and applying them to retrieval or reasoning.
* Strong context engineering and prompt design for complex agent workflows.
* Experience building or integrating MCP servers and clients, and working knowledge of the A2A protocol.
* Proficiency in Python, REST/gRPC APIs, and asynchronous programming.
* Solid grasp of LLM failure modes (hallucination, prompt injection, context limits) and their mitigations.

Trillion is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered for positions without regard to race, religion, gender, native origin, age, disability, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: AI Developer Experience Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

More and more PlanetScale databases are created, connected and queried by AI agents. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and a growing list of other tools now sit between developers and their infrastructure.

You will own that experience end to end. You'll make sure PlanetScale shows up everywhere developers build with AI, that our MCP server and CLI work flawlessly in every agent, and that we can measure how well it all works. Then you'll show the world how to do it well through demos, docs, blog posts, videos, and conferences.

This is a hands-on role combining engineering, content creation, and a strong public voice. You'll work closely with the teams that build our MCP server, CLI, API and docs.

The landscape of how developers work with AI changes fast. You'll have the opportunity to move quickly, experiment, and take the lead on the future of AI use with databases and infrastructure.

**Make PlanetScale great with AI tools**
----------------------------------------

* Build and maintain the plugins for PlanetScale in every AI marketplace and directory: agent plugins, skill registries, MCP directories, IDE extension stores and AI app builders
* Own our integrations with AI coding tools, agent frameworks and platforms
* Stay current with AI tools as they launch and ensure our customers have a great experience from day one
* Test the PlanetScale MCP server and CLI across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and other clients, and catch regressions before users do
* Find friction in creating a database, connecting, running migrations and debugging queries from inside an agent, then fix it or drive the fix with the owning team
* Improve the context agents rely on: tool descriptions, skills, llms.txt, docs written for agents, and error messages agents can act on
* Attention to AEO (answer engine optimization): make sure agents find and recommend PlanetScale
* Build and maintain skills for working with Postgres, MySQL, Vitess, Neki, and PlanetScale

**Measure how well we're doing**
--------------------------------

* Build evals that run real agent tasks against PlanetScale databases
* Benchmark how agents perform with PlanetScale and work towards continuous improvement
* Track how often AI assistants and agents recommend PlanetScale for database questions, and whether what they say about us is accurate
* Instrument and report on agent usage: databases created by agents, time to first connection, MCP versus CLI usage, and where sessions fail

**Show people how to do it well**
---------------------------------

* Build demos and sample apps that show PlanetScale and AI tooling at their best
* Write docs, guides and blog posts on using databases effectively with AI, including safe access, branching and performance assessment
* Make videos and attend conferences to communicate with our audience how to build effectively with AI

**These attributes best describe you**
--------------------------------------

* Daily use of AI coding agents, with strong opinions about what makes a tool work well with them
* Experience building an MCP server, plugin, CLI or SDK that real developers use
* Software engineering background in languages like TypeScript and Go, and comfort with APIs, OAuth and the command line
* Experience with writing docs, blogs, and / or video content creation
* Good at communicating with a broad audience and customers alike on socials
* Experience working with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite), schema design, migrations, connection handling, and Postgres or MySQL in production
* Data fluency: designing evals, writing the queries behind a dashboard, and telling a real trend from noise
* Clear communication of technical ideas in writing, on video and on stage
* Independence and speed: spotting a gap, shipping a fix, and telling people about it
* Genuine curiosity about the AI tooling landscape and a habit of keeping up with it

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Contributions to the MCP spec, SDKs or popular open-source MCP servers
* Experience writing agent skills, plugins or rules files for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex
* Experience with LLM eval tools and building benchmarks for agents
* Experience with AEO or GEO, or with tracking how LLMs surface and recommend a product
* A blog, YouTube channel or GitHub that developers already follow
* Experience with Vitess, database sharding, or running databases at scale
  

### **Why PlanetScale**

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

### **Total Compensation and Pay Transparency**

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

Base Salary Range: $170,000 - $220,000

jobs.title: Research Engineer, AI
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

**Job Summary**
===============

Lead applied research in one or more Orbis AI focus areas — agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, and high-performance analytics — and carry the results into the product. You will frame the problem, survey what already exists, build prototypes that test a real hypothesis, and measure honestly enough to act on the answer. The role exists because our advantage comes from turning advanced research into dependable mission capability.

**Travel**: Up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Frame research problems drawn from real product and mission gaps, define what a result must show to be worth productizing, and survey existing work before building.
* Build prototypes that isolate the question being asked, at the fidelity the question actually requires.
* Run rigorous experiments — baselines, ablations, held-out evaluation, and honest error analysis — with methodology another engineer can reproduce.
* Build and maintain the datasets and evaluation harnesses your area depends on, including cases that capture known failure modes.
* Report results clearly, negative results included, and make a defensible recommendation to continue, pivot, or stop.
* Transition validated results into production alongside product engineers, staying involved through the handoff rather than delivering a notebook.
* Contribute to the scientific community through publications, open-source releases, and academic collaborations, and advise Orbis on what in the field is worth adopting.
* Travel up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 3+ years of applied research or research-engineering experience, or an M.S./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field with equivalent applied work
* Strong Python engineering skills, producing research code another engineer can read, run, and build on
* Demonstrated experience designing and running experiments that produced an actionable conclusion, with methodology you can defend
* Depth in at least one Orbis AI focus area: agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, or high-performance analytics
* Working knowledge of modern LLM and retrieval methods and their practical limitations
* Clear technical writing that makes a result legible to engineers and non-specialist stakeholders alike
* Willingness to travel up to 20%

**Desired Qualifications**
==========================

* Publication record, open-source contributions, or academic collaborations in a relevant area
* Experience carrying a research result all the way into a production system
* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, reasoning systems, or information extraction
* Experience with agent architectures, planning, or multi-agent coordination
* Experience with model training, fine-tuning, or evaluation at scale
* Experience with performance engineering on data-intensive or analytical workloads
* Familiarity with OSINT, intelligence, or investigative research workflows

**Physical Requirements**
=========================

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
* Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
* **Travel**: Up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

**Orbis Benefits**

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

**Orbis Locations**

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

  

*Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,*

*qualifications, and business need. Orbis does

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platform Lead (Horizon AI)
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
**Data Platform Lead**
----------------------

Horizon AI is building the operating system for how organizations run themselves. The first step is autonomous data centers. A fleet of AI agents senses the state of STN’s GPU infrastructure, reasons about what it finds, and increasingly acts on it. This is running in production against real fleet data, not a prototype. Agents already take action where the risk is bounded and the outcome is verifiable. Everything riskier arrives as a recommendation for a human, and the work is moving decisions from the second category into the first, one class at a time, on evidence rather than optimism.

Data centers are the proving ground, not the destination. We start here because infrastructure is measurable and unforgiving: an agent is either right, or the fleet tells you it was wrong. What we build here generalizes, and we know where it goes next.

**Level:** Principal (MTS 5) · **Reports to:** Chief AI Officer

**The role.** Build the data foundation the platform reasons over. Today our agents assemble a picture of the fleet by querying several separate systems, and we cannot prove wider autonomy because we do not systematically capture how humans decide. You fix both.

**The problems you inherit**

* Fleet state is scattered across a relational store, a DCIM system, and multiple time-series and monitoring systems. Each has its own query path. There is no unified model. - No decision-capture pipeline exists. We record what agents did, but not what operators saw, concluded, and chose. That record is the evidence base for granting agents wider autonomy.
* Our retrieval pipeline is document-oriented rather than fleet-state-oriented.
* We consume telemetry from systems other teams operate, where retention and granularity are tuned for dashboards rather than for learning from history.

**You will**

* Design and build the fleet knowledge model: assets, topology, configuration, and current state, queryable by an agent in one call rather than five
* Build the decision-capture pipeline, and instrument the operator workflow so we accumulate labelled human decisions from day one
* Own the data access layer that abstracts telemetry sources, so we can keep consuming today and build our own collection if that stops scaling
* Negotiate our requirements with the teams who own the telemetry: signals, granularity, retention, raw event access
* Own the scale path, including vector index behaviour and the analytics separation a growing schema will eventually need

**You have**

* Strong data modelling judgment, particularly modelling physical or infrastructure domains as something queryable
* Experience with time-series and event data at scale, including cardinality and retention trade-offs
* Depth in PostgreSQL, including vector search, and comfort with a large evolving schema - Enough infrastructure literacy to know what a fleet actually is: nodes, GPUs, fabric, schedulers, power. Familiarity with DCIM tooling is a strong plus
* A bias toward shipping a usable model early over designing a complete one

**Nice to have:** GPU fleet or HPC exposure, DCGM, Slurm, entity resolution across inconsistent sources

jobs.title: Research Engineer, AI (Entry-Level)
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

**Job Summary**
===============

Support applied research across the Orbis AI focus areas — agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, and high-performance analytics — working alongside senior research engineers on questions with real product stakes. You will reproduce baselines, build evaluation datasets and harnesses, run experiments, and write up what actually happened. This role exists to bring strong early-career engineers into applied AI research and grow them toward owning a research area.

**Travel**: Occasional, up to 10%, for conferences, training, and team collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Reproduce baselines and published methods, and document precisely where your results diverge from what was reported.
* Build and maintain evaluation datasets and harnesses, including cases that capture known failure modes.
* Run experiments designed with senior research engineers, keeping records complete enough that someone else can rerun them.
* Perform error analysis — characterize what the system got wrong and why, and report it without smoothing it over.
* Implement well-scoped prototype components with design direction and code review from senior engineers.
* Summarize relevant literature and open-source work, and explain how it bears on the question at hand.
* Write up results, negative results included, and present them in team research reviews.
* Travel occasionally, up to 10%, for conferences, training, and team collaboration.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 0-2 years of professional experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated ability
* Solid programming fundamentals in Python, with code you can walk us through and defend
* Working understanding of machine learning and LLM fundamentals — evaluation basics, prompting, embeddings, and retrieval — from coursework, projects, internships, or professional work
* Ability to read a technical paper and explain what it claims, how it was evaluated, and where it might not hold
* Intellectual honesty about results, including the ones that undercut a hypothesis you liked
* Willingness to travel occasionally, up to 10%

**Desired Qualifications**
==========================

* Research experience from a thesis, lab, internship, or open-source project
* Hands-on project experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, or fine-tuning
* Exposure to graph databases, ontologies, or information extraction
* Experience with experiment tracking and evaluation tooling such as notebooks, dataset construction, or scoring pipelines
* Exposure to containerized environments (Docker) and cloud or GPU compute
* Interest in OSINT, intelligence, or investigative research workflows

**Physical Requirements**
=========================

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
* Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
* **Travel**: Occasional, up to 10%, for conferences, training, and team collaboration.

**Orbis Benefits**

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

**Orbis Locations**

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

jobs.description:
**About Onescreen**

Onescreen is the modern platform for out-of-home advertising — making it easier for brands and agencies to plan, buy, and measure OOH campaigns across thousands of vendors and formats. We move fast, operate lean, and hold ourselves to a high standard on every campaign we run.

**About the role**

You'll be the founding ML engineer who owns our matching algorithms from exploration through production and the data platform that feeds them. You'll design and ship the models that rank OOH inventory against advertiser personas, markets, and dayparts. You'll own our data warehouse shape and the pipelines that fill it. You'll publish the ranking and matching APIs that downstream products, agents, and automation surfaces consume.

**What you'll do**

* Design and ship matching and ranking models for OOH inventory: candidate generation, re-ranking, geospatial-aware scoring.
* Own the data warehouse layer end to end: staging, marts, feature pipelines, freshness, lineage.
* Stand up offline and online evaluation infrastructure — measure the gap between them, don't assume it.
* Publish ranking and matching APIs for product surfaces, with latency and quality SLOs.
* Instrument model monitoring: drift detection, prediction distribution, feature freshness, retraining triggers.

### **Qualifications**

**The hard requirement:** you have owned a production ranking, matching, or recommendation system end-to-end. You chose the model, designed the features, made the evaluation methodology calls, and were on the hook when it drifted. We care about that ownership scope more than years on a résumé — title and compensation are scaled to your demonstrated expertise.

Beyond that:

* Strong production Python (NumPy, Pandas, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy).
* Strong SQL and modern data warehouse experience (BigQuery preferred).
* Real ranking and matching modeling fluency — learning-to-rank, retrieval and re-rank patterns, not just classification.
* Evaluation methodology rigor: holdouts, leakage prevention, online vs. offline gap measurement.
* Comfort owning the data pipeline as well as the model.
* Bias toward shipping. Clear writer. Self-directed.

#### **Nice to have**

* Geospatial data experience (H3, PostGIS, GeoPandas)
* Mobility or location data experience
* Embedding-based retrieval (pgvector, FAISS, vector databases)
* Bandits, contextual bandits, or online learning
* A/B testing infrastructure design
* Causal inference
* dbt
* Ad-tech or OOH domain familiarity
