jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  
Silverthorne Advisory Group is seeking a skilled and highly motivated Data Engineer to join an exciting and growing opportunity within the Defense sector. As a Data Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and maintaining our client's cloud and data infrastructure and systems. Your expertise in ETL, Databricks, Python, Spark, Scala, JavaScript/JSON, SQL, and Jupyter Notebooks will be essential in ensuring efficient data processing and analysis.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Design, develop, and implement end-to-end data pipelines, utilizing ETL processes and technologies such as Databricks, Python, Spark, Scala, JavaScript/JSON, SQL, and Jupyter Notebooks.
* Create and optimize data pipelines from scratch, ensuring scalability, reliability, and high-performance processing.
* Perform data cleansing, data integration, and data quality assurance activities to maintain the accuracy and integrity of large datasets.
* Leverage big data technologies to efficiently process and analyze large datasets, particularly those encountered in a federal agency.
* Troubleshoot data-related problems and provide innovative solutions to address complex data challenges.

Implement and enforce data governance policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  

* Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and design optimal data models and architectures.
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and stakeholders to provide timely and accurate data insights and support decision-making processes.
* Maintain documentation for software applications, workflows, and processes.
* Stay updated with emerging trends and advancements in data engineering and recommend suitable tools and technologies for continuous improvement.

,
  
Required Skills
  
  

* 3+ years of experience in the related field.
* U.S. citizenship with an active Secret clearance (we can sponsor).
* Strong SQL knowledge: Ability to write, troubleshoot, and modify complex SQL procedures and queries across a variety of datasets.
* Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) experience: Experience with establishing and maintaining data load processes as well as manipulating and combining various data sources.
* Business Intelligence experience: Creating and updating applications, reports, dashboards, etc. Cognos Analytics, Qlik Sense, and Power BI especially are relevant to the role.
* Python and Coding experience: Hands-on experience with languages/technologies such as Python, Spark, Scala, JavaScript/JSON, and SQL.

,
  
Desired Skills
  
  

* Databricks experience: Familiarity with Databricks, Amazon AWS/S3, Jupyter Notebooks will be helpful in the role.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to solve complex data-related issues.
* Demonstrated experience working with large datasets and leveraging big data technologies to process and analyze data efficiently.
* Understanding of data modeling/visualization, database design principles, and data governance practices.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Detail-oriented mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
* Teradata experience is a plus. Knowledge of Multiloads, BTEQs, and other assorted Teradata procedures will be helpful in the role.
* Accounting knowledge is a plus. Some background on DoD accounting system (DEAMS, TFMS, NERP etc.) and transportation policies will be helpful in the role.

,
  
Additional Details
  
  

* Compensation - We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, including but not limited to prior experience, skills, expertise, location, and other considerations permitted by law.
* Healthcare - We offer Health, Vision, and Dental Plans for our employees and their families.
* Retirement Plan – We invest in your future with a competitive 401(k) plan, where we match 100% of your contributions up to your first 6% and give you access to Vanguard Admiral funds.
* Paid Time Off - Based on length of service, we offer a generous amount of paid leave.
* Bonus System – As you invest in us, we invest in you. We offer bonuses to all employees who meet and exceed goals throughout the year.
* Professional Development – Support for career growth through training programs and certifications.
* Company Retreats & Team Events – Sponsored trips, team-building activities, and annual conferences related to your skillset.

,
  
About Silverthorne Advisory Group, LLC.
  
  
We are a data, cloud engineering, management and IT consulting firm. We help our clients transform their businesses by leveraging innovative technology solutions to optimize business processes, scale technology, and drive data-driven decision-making.
  
  
What sets us apart? Expert talent, deep collaboration, and a relentless focus on impact. Our team - comprised of former industry leaders and top-tier consultants - combines big-firm expertise with the agility and client focus of a boutique firm. We listen first, tailor solutions to each client’s needs, and leave organizations stronger than when we arrived.
  
  
At Silverthorne, we don’t just consult - we transform. Let’s shape the future together!

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**DATA ENGINEER** // EAGLE BROOK CHURCH

  

**JOB OBJECTIVES**

  

* Helps build and maintain reliable data infrastructure that supports reporting, analytics, and business intelligence across Eagle Brook Church
* Ensures data is accurate, accessible, and fit for purpose by maintaining data pipelines, warehouses, and integrations
* Partners with the Data team and ministry stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver effective technical solutions
* Supports the reliability, scalability, and usability of the data environment through ongoing technical contributions
* Reports to the Technology Data Manager

  

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

  

* Designs and implements data models, schemas, and integration topology in alignment with established data architecture direction and standards

* Helps establish and maintain data engineering standards, naming conventions, coding patterns, and development best practices across the Data team

* Maintains technical documentation for pipelines, schemas, integrations, data flows, and architectural decisions

* Develops, documents, and supports data pipelines, workflows, and automation for ingestion, transformation, processing, and scheduling

* Ingests data from external sources through APIs and system-to-system integrations

* Maintains and supports the Data Warehouse and the HR Data Warehouse, ensuring performance, reliability, and continuity of all data feeds

* Prepares and models incoming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets for reporting and analytics consumers

* Maintains data accuracy and integrity across pipelines and warehouses through auditing, validation, and monitoring

* Administers data security controls, including permissions, roles, and access policies across warehouse and pipeline environments, in accordance with established security and compliance standards

* Assists with incident response when critical data feeds or pipelines fail, including diagnosis, remediation, and stakeholder communication

* Collaborates with reporting and analytics consumers, including ministry stakeholders, to understand data needs and ensure pipelines deliver fit-for-purpose datasets

* Shares engineering best practices and documentation with the Data team

* Provides input on tools and platform improvements for the data engineering stack

  

**OTHER JOB FUNCTIONS**

  

* Assists with onboarding new team members, as needed

* Other duties as assigned

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

  

Minimum Qualifications

  

* Follower of Jesus and aligns with Eagle Brook Church's 9 core beliefs

* 3+ years of related experience

* Strong SQL and Python skills

* Proficient in data pipeline and ETL/ELT development, using tool such as Azure Data Factory or Azure Synapse

* Proficient in data warehouse design and management

* Strong API and system integration skills

* Familiarity with data security, access governance, and role-based permission models

* Experience with Microsoft Azure (Logic Apps, Functions, Storage)

* Experience with Git-based source control and CI/CD

* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Gemini, or similar

  

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a related field

* Experience with Azure SQL or Microsoft Fabric

* Experience with Data Analysis Expressions (DAX) and Power BI

  

**JOB DETAILS**

  

* Location: Centerville, MN

* FLSA Status: Exempt / Salary

* Salary Range: $75,000 - $78,000

* Employment Classification: Full Time

* Regular / Temporary: Regular

* Workdays: Monday – Friday (generally)

* Work Hours: 8:00 am – 4:30 pm (generally)

* Remote Eligible: may be eligible to work remotely 1 day per week

* Ministry / Department: Operations

* Team: Technology

  

**WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

  

* Regular communication with others to exchange information

* Regular remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods

* Regular repeating motions that may include wrists, hands, and/or fingers

  

**BENEFITS**

  

Eagle Brook Church’s benefit plan is designed to help you stay healthy, feel secure, and maintain work/life balance. Offering a competitive benefits package is just one way we strive to provide our employees with a rewarding workplace. We offer the following benefits to our full-time employees:

  

* medical, dental, and vision coverage

* health savings account (HSA)

* dependent care FSA

* employer-provided life insurance + additional voluntary life insurance

* accident and critical illness insurance

* employer-provided short-term and long-term disability

* paid family and medical leave (PFML)

* member assistance program (MAP)

* generous paid time off and holidays

* 403(b) retirement plan with employer contribution

* development dollars for team members to invest in their professional growth

* casual dress and work environment

  

**APPLICANTS WITH DISABILITIES**

  

Eagle Brook Church provides reasonable accommodation for its employees and applicants with disabilities. If you have a disability and need assistance in searching or applying for jobs with Eagle Brook Church, call 651-429-9227 or email staffing@eaglebrookchurch.com and let us know the support you need.

* Strong experience with Elasticsearch or AWS OpenSearch, including indexing and query optimization
* Experience writing and tuning complex queries using SQL and search query languages
* Experience integrating AWS services such as Lambda, SNS, SQS, S3, EC2, and related cloud-native services
* Strong programming experience in Python
* Experience with Linux systems and shell scripting
* Experience building and deploying Docker containers
* Experience working with distributed cloud systems and event-driven architectures
* Experience transforming and processing data across multiple formats (JSON, CSV, XML)
* Experience using AWS CDK (required – not substitutable with Terraform or CloudFormation)
* Experience collaborating with developers to implement infrastructure and deployment solutions

**Program Overview**

GDIT delivers critical all‑source intelligence on foreign military and civilian cyber actors, their infrastructure, and the broader ecosystems in which they operate. This intelligence directly supports foundational military intelligence (FMI) requirements for the joint force and aligns with mission portfolios.

jobs.description:
**The work**

We are seeking to build a team to implement LLM models into our current analytic environment. This role ranges from Senior to Junior level Software/Data Engineers to provide hands-on application engineering: agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, tool integration, and the backend services that hold it together, deployed into a classified enterprise environment.

**What you’ll do**

Work varies with experience, but expect a mix of:

*Build agent components.* Implement orchestration logic, tool integrations, and memory handling within agent-based applications with design support early on and increasing ownership as you go.

*Work the retrieval pipeline.* Document processing, embedding generation, retrieval configuration, prompt assembly. This is where most people learn what actually makes RAG work, and where you’ll spend real time.

*Write the services.* Python REST APIs supporting data retrieval, system integration, and agent workflows.

*Handle the data.* Process and transform structured and unstructured data for AI workflows; work with Postgres schemas and query performance.

*Ship to production.* Testing, deployment, and the enterprise realities of a classified environment.

**Junior-level**

We’re looking for a working software engineer who wants to move into AI. You should bring:

* Solid Python, with real production code behind you
* Experience building or consuming REST APIs
* Comfort with databases and SQL
* *Some* hands-on exposure to LLMs or a RAG prototype, an agent you wired up, a side project, a course. Curiosity you can point at, not a credential
* Bachelor’s in computer science or a related field (additional experience considered in lieu)

You do not need prior professional AI work. We’ll teach the domain.

**Mid-level**

Same foundation, plus you’ve shipped something AI-enabled:

* Hands-on work building LLM-integrated applications, RAG workflows, or retrieval-based systems

* Understanding of the fundamentals: how transformers behave, why context windows matter, where retrieval breaks down

**Senior-level**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience overall with recent hands-on work building AI/ML applications
* Bachelor’s in computer science or a related field
* Strong Python and fluency with common data and AI libraries
* Demonstrated experience with LLM-integrated applications, RAG workflows, or similar retrieval-based systems

* You must have hands-on experience architecting and securing enterprise data storage and analytics services across both AWS and Microsoft Azure environments.
* You must have experience designing, accrediting, and operating data platforms within classified DoD environments.
* You must possess an active Top Secret security clearance with current SCI eligibility (TS/SCI).

We are looking for a Software Engineer in Test with an interest in embedded firmware to join our IoT (Internet of Things) group. The group develops software for the microcontroller-based sensor hardware designed and manufactured in-house. Our products offer an interesting engineering challenge: microcontrollers with just a few hundred kilobytes of RAM and code space must collect data from sensors such as accelerometers and GPS, communicate with back-end systems over the Internet and nearby devices with Bluetooth, perform over-the-air upgrades with new firmware, and manage cryptographically-secured storage — all while using so little power that they can run for years on a battery.

CMT is looking for a **Software Engineer in Test II, Embedded Firmware** to help us change the world. CMT has helped protect over 65 million drivers and prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. We build AI to solve some of the most difficult challenges in mobility — understanding and reducing risk, detecting crashes, and getting people life-saving help. The problems are hard. The impact is real. No matter your role, your work will matter at CMT.

**Responsibilities:**

* Use independent judgment and responsibility to contribute to the development and maintenance of test infrastructure for firmware validation under the guidance of senior engineers
* Execute and monitor firmware test runs across simulated firmware on Linux servers and real firmware on device
* Write and maintain automated tests to improve coverage and enhance failure visibility
* Use Python for test harnesses and scripting, with exposure to C for understanding firmware under test
* Use Linux for development and git for source code management
* Learn and apply knowledge of embedded microcontroller systems as it relates to firmware testing
* Assist with test systems attached to equipment capable of measuring parameters like power usage • Gain familiarity with microcontroller circuit boards (e.g., Arduino-like devices), multimeters, benchtop power supplies, and electronic schematics

* Complete any additional tasks as they arise

* 2+ years of relevant working experience
* Proficiency in Python programming; willingness to read and understand C
* Comfortable working on the Linux command-line and performing basic system administration tasks
* Experience writing and running automated tests, ideally in a CI environment
* Familiarity with git and standard development workflows
* Familiarity with Docker and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) is a plus
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
* Collaborative with the ability to work with diverse teams across the globe
* Eager to learn and grow — a "leave things better than you found them" mindset

**Nice to Haves:**

**The Team**  
  
Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required**:**

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

* 4+ years of experience with design patterns and principles - Command, Strategy, Factory, etc., and applying one without overengineering
* 4+ years of experience in API design - versioning, idempotency, error handling, and the tradeoffs between REST, RPC, and event-driven approaches

4+ years of experience in Model Context Protocol (MCP)

jobs.title: Scientific Software Engineer – Machine Programming
jobs.description:
**Summary**

This role helps the scientists who build and operate QuEra's neutral-atom quantum computers program those machines effectively. You will maintain the domain-specific language and compiler stack, built on the open-source Kirin toolchain, that experimental physicists use every day to run their experiments.

You will work closely with physicists and control stack engineers. You'll help machine teams turn new experiments into working programs, keep the toolchain reliable as our hardware evolves, and drive its integration with our control system. The role suits an engineer who enjoys building tools and also helping others succeed with them.

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain the domain-specific language and its compilation stack: triage issues, fix bugs, review pull requests, manage releases and keep CI, tests and dependencies healthy.
* Act as the point of contact for machine and testbed teams programming their experiments. Help them build new experiments, port legacy programs and diagnose compilation or runtime problems.
* Work with control stack engineers on integrating compiled programs with our control system. This includes defining and evolving the program representation passed between the compiler and the control system, keeping the two in sync across releases, and debugging problems that span both.
* Turn user problems into minimal reproducible reports, regression tests and focused fixes, and work with the compiler team on larger language or IR changes.
* Find and fix performance problems in program compilation and execution, such as compile time, program size and timing correctness.
* Write and maintain user-facing documentation, tutorials, example programs and agent skills that make it easier for physicists to write correct programs.
* Work with the hardware control team to support new channel types, control hardware and machine configurations.
* Collect feedback from machine users and turn it into a prioritized roadmap for usability improvements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong Python skills, including type hints, packaging and testing (pytest).
* Enjoys building tools for, and working closely with, scientists who are not professional software developers. Clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience working across team boundaries: agreeing on interfaces, coordinating changes between components and debugging problems that span several systems.
* Experience debugging unfamiliar code and reducing complex failures to minimal reproductions.
* Familiarity with the full software lifecycle: version control, code review, testing, CI/CD, logging, profiling, debugging and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with compilers, domain-specific languages or SSA-based intermediate representations (experience with Kirin, MLIR or LLVM is a plus).
* Background in experimental physics, especially AMO or atomic physics lab control (AWGs, AOMs/AODs, DDS, timing systems, cameras).
* Experience with real-time or embedded control systems, FPGAs, or experiment-control frameworks such as ARTIQ or Labscript.
* Experience with real-time scheduling or execution systems, such as runtime schedulers, streaming or instruction-dispatch systems.
* Experience with C++ or Rust.
* Contributions to open-source libraries.
* Experience using AI coding agents in a development workflow.

The approximate base salary range for this position is $102,400 - $166,400.

We consistently monitor external market data and update base salary ranges accordingly. We determine base compensation decisions on several factors, including as geographic placement, role-specific knowledge, skills, and/or experience. In addition to our base salary offerings, we also provide equity grants for all new hires.

QuEra is committed to cultivating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We highly value diversity in our current and future employees and do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Would you like to join a team of world class researchers and engineers collectively focused on developing systems critical to national security? Are you seeking an opportunity to work in an environment where big ideas, sound technical arguments and sponsor impacts are valued? Then MITRE might be the place for you!

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience developing, integrating, and debugging software for simulated and physical robotic systems.
* Experience with physics simulation environments (such as MuJoCo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, or Gazebo) for modeling robots, testing software stacks, or validating sim-to-real transfer.
* Experience integrating sensor streams (cameras, IMUs, encoders, or tactile sensors), actuator interfaces, and real-time control loops into a robotics software stack.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience building core components of a robotics software stack, SDK, or hardware abstraction layer.
* Experience developing, deploying, or running machine learning policies (such as Vision-Language-Action models or reinforcement learning controllers) on physical robots.
* Experience with system identification, actuator and sensor modeling, or closing the sim-to-real gap for manipulation or locomotion.
* Experience with teleoperation systems, motion tracking hardware, wearable data collection devices, or multi-fingered dexterous hands.
* Experience designing automated calibration verification, system health monitoring, or hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test pipelines.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, research-focused Software Engineers are embedded throughout the company, allowing them to setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, engineers work on real-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers.

As a Robotics Research Engineer, you will connect physical and simulated robot platforms to our research and machine learning software stack. Your core focus is to build a unified software interface across physics simulation and physical hardware so that models, teleoperation systems, and evaluation tools run seamlessly in both domains. Working in our Cambridge lab alongside hardware, simulation, and machine learning teams, you will bring up new robotic platforms, end effectors, and wearable devices and make them ready for research.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Integrate robot control software and hardware interfaces with our common robotics SDK across simulated and physical platforms, end effectors, and wearable devices.
* Build, validate, and maintain physics simulation environments and software-in-the-loop harnesses that accurately model the on-robot software stack, control loops, and hardware interfaces.
* Run and maintain the on-robot execution harness to call local and remote machine learning action models in real time.
* Connect platforms to the teleoperation and data logging stack to capture synchronized sensor streams, robot actions, and demonstrations for model training.
* Develop platforms with fleet orchestration and evaluation tools to run standardized benchmarks and guide data collection.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. *Every day, our team members do amazing things in pursuit of our shared purpose to build trust with our clients, partners, subcontractors, and teammates. No matter your background, education, or career path, if you share our vision to create extraordinary experiences, you belong* ***at HITT****.*

Robotics Software Engineer - Construction

**Job Description:**
====================

The Robotics Software Engineer is responsible for developing and deploying autonomous robotics solutions that must operate in some of the most challenging real-world environments. This role will own work across the development lifecycle: creating proof-of-concept prototypes, maturing promising concepts into feature-complete systems, and hardening those systems for reliable deployment on jobsites.

This team member reports to the Robotics Software Lead and is part of HITT’s Robotics Team, which leads research and development, pilot programs, and full-time field deployments. The Robotics Team’s mission is to support our project teams, transform our industry, and bring robots to every jobsite.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who has a deep system-level understanding of what it takes for robots to operate in unstructured environments, handle dynamic obstacles, safely work around people, and work reliably with limited networking and power infrastructure. Although they may specialize in autonomy, perception, or manipulation, they are comfortable contributing across the robotics stack and addressing issues that span software, sensors, compute, networking, and mechanical hardware. They can move quickly when building an early proof-of-concept while applying the engineering discipline needed to mature it into a field-ready solution.

We encourage strong candidates excited by this role to apply even if they do not match every technical qualification listed.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Robotics Software & Systems Integration

* Design, develop, integrate, and test software for complex field robotics applications.
* Support the development and maturation of the HITT robotics software stack.
* Integrate robot platforms, sensors, actuators, embedded computers, networks, and operator interfaces into cohesive systems.
* Develop field-ready autonomy capabilities, including localization, mapping, navigation, state estimation, and mission planning.
* Integrate perception pipelines using cameras, LiDAR, depth sensors, inertial sensors, and other sensing modalities.
* Develop manipulation applications involving motion planning, controls, end effectors, calibration, and task execution.
* Use simulation, synthetic data, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and repeatable test environments to accelerate development and reduce field risk.
* Configure and troubleshoot network connectivity on robots, sensors, operator interfaces, and cloud services using wired and wireless networks.
* Serve as a strong technical contributor across the stack while bringing depth in one or more of these areas; expertise in every discipline is not expected.

Collaboration & Partnerships

* Collaborate with software engineers, hardware engineers, field testing engineers, vendors, partners, end users, and other stakeholders.
* Integrate and extend third-party technologies using APIs, SDKs, middleware, and other software interfaces.
* Contribute to co-development efforts with vendors and technology partners to establish technical requirements, resolve integration challenges, and evaluate solutions.

Field Testing & Deployment

* Plan and execute structured testing in the lab, at test sites, and on active construction projects.
* Deploy alongside field teams, observe real workflows, collect data, diagnose issues, and convert field feedback into engineering priorities.
* Design for difficult real-world conditions, including dust, changing lighting, uneven terrain, vibration, intermittent connectivity, dynamic obstacles, and frequent environmental change.
* Support deployed systems through remote and on-site troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Document architectures, interfaces, test results, deployment procedures, and lessons learned so solutions can be supported and scaled.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in robotics, computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or 2+ years of experience in developing, integrating, and testing field robotics systems.
* Proficiency in C++, Python, and Linux-based robotics development.
* Proficiency in modern software-engineering practices, including version control (e.g., Git), automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker).
* Experience working with APIs/SDKs, open-source software packages, and technical standards to bring together disparate technology components into a reliable solution.
* Fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor).
* Strong system-level troubleshooting skills across software, hardware, networking, and field operations.
* Ability to work effectively in uncertain, fast-moving environments and take ownership of open-ended technical problems.
* Ability to effectively communicate complex technical topics in written and verbal formats to various audiences.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to prioritize tasks across multiple projects.
* Willingness to travel to active construction sites and participate directly in testing and deployment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience developing robotic systems for construction, manufacturing, logistics, agriculture, mining, defense, or other demanding real-world environments.
* Experience developing robotic systems using Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) or comparable robotics middleware.
* Experience in mobile robot perception, SLAM, and navigation for ground and/or aerial robots.
* Experience developing or integrating mobile manipulation systems,

new_jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Data centers run on thousands of sensors, meters, and control systems, and the teams who run their power infrastructure have to make sense of all of it in real time. Teserac is building Neuron™, an AI-native observability and automation platform that gives those teams full visibility into their power operations and helps them get ahead of problems. At its core is an AI teammate that works alongside every operator around the clock: detecting anomalies, correlating events, and recommending what to do next.

As a Full Stack Developer, you'll own features end to end, from the ingestion path that pulls telemetry off a BMS in a live facility, through the time-series layer that stores it, to the dashboard an operator is watching at 2am.

This is a small team with real customers in production. Your code ships in days, not quarters, and it runs in facilities where being wrong has physical consequences. You'll work directly with the Principal Software & Architecture Lead, Product, and Solution Engineering. We move fast, avoid bureaucracy, and expect engineers to own outcomes rather than tickets.

This is a hybrid role based in our Santa Clara office, and visa sponsorship is available.

**Who We Are Looking For**

You're a full-stack engineer who is comfortable on both sides of the line, and who gets interested rather than annoyed when the data is messy, the vendor's API is undocumented, and the protocol spec is a PDF from 2009. You likely:

* Build front to back. You can trace a value from a Modbus register to a rendered chart without handing off, and you know where it's likely to break.
* Take databases seriously. You know that a query plan, an index, and a migration on a large table are engineering decisions, not configuration.
* Have worked with real time-series data at a volume where naive approaches stop working, and understand what that costs at read time and write time.
* Debug production calmly. When CPU is pinned and a queue is backing up, you reason from evidence rather than restarting things.
* Use AI tooling well. You get real leverage from Cursor, Claude Code, or similar, and your standards didn't drop when you started using it.

**What You'll Do**

**Product and front end**

* Build operator-facing features for Neuron™ in React and TypeScript: real-time dashboards, alerting, alarm and ticket workflows, capacity planning views, and power-flow visualizations.
* Build the interfaces the AI teammate works through: interaction panels, recommendation displays, approval workflows, and audit trails.
* Keep large, data-dense views fast and responsive across devices.

**Data ingestion and integrations**

* Build and maintain the ingestion path that brings telemetry from customer sites into Neuron™: edge collectors, MQTT over AWS IoT Core, queue-based workers, and normalization into a canonical metric model.
* Write integration modules against real building and power systems: Siemens Desigo, Schneider PME and EcoStruxure, Niagara, Eaton, and generic BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP sources.
* Own the correctness of what lands: point mapping, unit and phase semantics, deduplication, and backfill.

**Time-series platform**

* Develop against PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB: hypertables, continuous aggregates, compression, and retention.
* Design schema and migrations that stay safe as tables grow into the billions of rows.
* Find and fix the performance problems that only appear with real customer data volumes.

**Quality and operations**

* Write tested, reviewed code, and contribute to CI/CD and automated testing.
* Troubleshoot production issues across the stack, and share on-call as the platform scales.

**Why Teserac**

We're not building incremental improvements to legacy tools. We're re-architecting how data centers see, understand, and act on their own operations.

* Ship features that directly shape how some of the world's most critical AI infrastructure is powered and managed.
* Join a small engineering team where every developer has outsized impact and direct visibility into product decisions.
* Work where AI, real-time systems, and physical infrastructure meet.
* Grow with the company from Series A through scale.

  
**Requirements**  

* **Required**
* + 7+ years building and shipping production software across the stack
  + Strong Python, ideally Django. Our backend is Django and Celery, and it's the language you'll write most days.
  + Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, query performance, and migrations you'd run against a live production database
  + Practical time-series experience. TimescaleDB is ideal, and deep experience with another time-series or high-volume streaming store transfers.
  + Solid React and TypeScript, and the judgment to keep a data-heavy interface fast
  + Experience with asynchronous and event-driven systems: task queues, pub/sub, streaming, or WebSockets
  + Comfortable on AWS. We run ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, and IoT Core.
  + Able to work independently, define your own scope from a rough requirement, and ship
* **Preferred**
* + Industrial or IoT telemetry experience: BMS, EPMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar OT data sources
  + Hands-on experience with industrial protocols: BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, or vendor BMS APIs
  + Data center infrastructure familiarity: power distribution topology, UPS and PDU behavior, or PUE
  + Experience building observability or monitoring products, commercial or internal
  + Early-stage startup experience, Seed through Series B
* Nobody checks every box here. If some of these describe you, apply.

  
**Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
* Free Food & Snacks
* Stock Option Plan
* 401(k)

Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights.

The Financial Crime and Risk Management (FCRM) team within Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) at American Express is building the next generation of AI-enabled world-class capabilities to support second-line risk and compliance functions and financial crime investigation teams.

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Actimize Engineer to help design, develop, enhance, and scale our NICE Actimize Suspicious Activity Monitoring (SAM) platform supporting Anti-Money Laundering (AML) transaction monitoring and regulatory compliance initiatives across the company.

The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise in Actimize SAM, strong software and data engineering skills, and experience delivering scalable, reliable, and high-performance AML transaction monitoring solutions. This role will play a critical part in modernizing our AML technology ecosystem, enhancing transaction monitoring capabilities, and supporting enterprise-wide platform reliability and AI readiness initiatives.

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering or enterprise application development, including significant hands-on experience with NICE Actimize SAM (Suspicious Activity Monitoring).
* Strong hands-on experience in Actimize SAM development, configuration, customization, implementation, and production support.
* Experience with Actimize Intelligence Server (AIS), SAM application architecture, scenario execution, and data processing components.
* Strong understanding of AML transaction monitoring scenarios, detection logic, thresholds, and transaction processing workflows.
* Proficiency in SQL and programming languages such as Java, Python, or other relevant technologies used for Actimize development and integration.
* Experience working with relational databases such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or PostgreSQL, including complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
* Experience with ETL processes, data mapping, data validation, and integration of large-scale transactional and customer datasets into Actimize SAM.
* Experience troubleshooting Actimize application performance, batch processing, scenario execution, and data integration issues.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration patterns, APIs, web services, and backend processing systems.
* Experience delivering scalable, secure, and highly available enterprise applications.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to develop technical specifications, document system processing flows, and translate functional requirements into technical implementations.

Preferred:

* Deep technical expertise in NICE Actimize SAM and AIS, including scenario development, application configuration, deployment, and production troubleshooting.
* Experience with Actimize SAM platform upgrades, version migrations, performance optimization, and modernization initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of Actimize SAM data models, transaction monitoring scenarios, detection logic, and underlying processing architecture.
* Experience optimizing large-scale AML transaction monitoring systems processing high volumes of financial transactions.
* Familiarity with AML regulatory requirements, including BSA/AML, KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), and Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR).
* Experience with cloud technologies, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and integration of Actimize solutions with cloud-based data platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automated testing, and application monitoring tools.
* Familiarity with distributed data processing, messaging frameworks, and enterprise-scale data integration architectures.
* Experience with database query optimization, batch processing performance tuning, and production stability improvements.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, lineage, and regulatory data management practices.
* Exposure to AI/ML-enabled AML transaction monitoring, advanced analytics, and modern financial crime detection capabilities.
Passion for engineering excellence, platform modernization, and solving complex enterprise-scale AML technology challenges.  

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills,

new_jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Senior Software Engineer - AI Platform (Michelangelo Feature Store)
  
  
**About the Team** The Michelangelo team builds and maintains the core Machine Learning platform that scales AI solutions across the enterprise. Within Michelangelo, the Feature Store team is responsible for the critical infrastructure that bridges data and real-time machine learning predictions. We build the high-performance feature serving layer that enables product teams and data scientists to deploy production-grade AI seamlessly, ensuring production systems have access to the right signals at exactly the right time.
  
  
**Role Overview** As a Senior Software Engineer on the Michelangelo Feature Store team, you will drive the technical direction of our real-time feature serving infrastructure. You will be responsible for tackling complex distributed systems challenges to deliver high-throughput, ultra-low-latency feature retrieval at enterprise scale. This role requires a blend of hands-on technical execution, architectural system design, and engineering mentorship.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* **Design & Build:** Own the architecture and implementation of highly scalable feature serving components, ensuring millisecond-latency feature retrieval for real-time ML applications.
* **Scale Infrastructure:** Develop robust streaming and online data serving systems that handle massive concurrent request volumes, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation under load.
* **System Performance:** Optimize platform efficiency by tuning underlying fast-access data stores and in-memory caches to guarantee strict low-latency SLAs.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, and product teams to translate feature engineering needs into generalized platform capabilities and elegant, developer-facing APIs.
* **Technical Leadership:** Lead technical design reviews, establish coding standards, and guide architectural decisions to minimize technical debt across the feature serving stack.
* **Mentorship:** Elevate the engineering bar by mentoring mid-level and junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.
* **Operational Excellence:** Own the production health of the feature serving layer. Define SLIs/SLOs, build comprehensive observability (metrics, distributed tracing), and participate in on-call rotations to ensure 99.99%+ reliability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating large-scale backend systems in production.
* Proficiency in one or more backend programming languages such as Go, Java, C++, or Python.
* Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, covering concurrency, consistency, data modeling, API design, and fault tolerance.
* Proven track record of leading the design and end-to-end delivery of complex, high-throughput, low-latency software services.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep understanding of fast-access NoSQL databases, in-memory caches, and key-value stores (e.g., Redis, Cassandra, DynamoDB) optimized for read-heavy workloads.
* Experience with real-time stream processing and event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, Flink).
* Background in building or scaling Feature Stores (e.g., Feast, Tecton) or similar high-performance data serving layers.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience writing comprehensive technical design documents.  

  
  
For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year - USD $224,000 per year.  
  
You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Software Engineer: Networking & Hardware-in-the-Loop**
========================================================

First Order Effects · Austin, TX

**Who We Are**
--------------

First Order Effects (FOE) is building America's Infrastructure Prime for the robotic era. Autonomous ships, drones, and robots are rewriting how the world moves, fights, and builds - but none of them work without infrastructure to power them, connect them, and launch and recover them. That's what we build.

**We've Built Cutting Edge Systems at Legendary Companies**
-----------------------------------------------------------

Our team comes from SpaceX, Anduril, Saronic, Lockheed Skunk Works, Forterra, and Fuse Energy. Before founding FOE, we built satellite ground stations that closed a national comms gap in days, deployed multi-megawatt power systems at commercial speed, and shipped autonomous surface vessels into Navy fleet production. We've built infrastructure at lightspeed before - now we're applying that playbook to an entire company.

**The Role**
------------

* Own the network inside Surge Hub, our rapidly deployable power system. Take today's early design and turn it into a secure, production-ready architecture.
* Segment traffic so control traffic stays isolated, while the devices that need internet connectivity get a clean, secure path out.
* Build for uptime: backup WAN, failover, and a network that holds when a link drops in the field.
* Design with security in mind from the first switch, not as a retrofit.
* Own the hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) test network in our Austin warehouse. Bring every Surge Hub component onto one test network and drive it with your code.
* Write portable test and automation software for Surge Hub and its test equipment, and integrate it with the product's C/C++ firmware and software.
* Build it from the ground up. You pick the equipment, set the architecture, and own the result.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design, build, and own HITL test systems: rack the hardware, connect it, and make software test it for real.
* Configure and maintain real networks, including switches, routers, VLANs, subnets, and firewalls, on hardware that ships.
* Live in Linux day to day.
* Write automation and test code in Python.
* Take projects from idea to outcome without waiting for a spec. Two or more years doing this on hardware products counts for more than a long resume of adjacent work.
* Bring a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or the shipped work that proves the same.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Network security depth: segmentation, hardening, firewall policy, and secure remote access.
* C and C++. Surge Hub firmware and software are written in them.
* A background in hardware or embedded products: power, aerospace, automotive, robotics, or defense. The domain matters less than the hardware.
* Startup experience, or time at a hard-tech company where you owned more than your title said.

**Compensation**
----------------

$140,000–$200,000 base + equity + benefits.

**ITAR requirement**
--------------------

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations (ITAR/EAR), applicants must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance; active clearance not required.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Object Storage Data Path & S3**

* Contribute to features in the ActiveScale data path, helping handle the flow from incoming S3 requests to durable storage across NVMe, HDD, and tape.

* Contribute to the implementation and extension of the S3 API, ensuring correct protocol behavior and efficient request handling.

* Analyze and help improve the latency, throughput, and reliability of the I/O pipeline, developing your Linux profiling and systems-debugging skills as you go.

**Durability, Data Placement & Resilience**

* Contribute to durability and data-placement work, including erasure coding, and help ensure correctness under failures such as node loss, disk faults, and partial writes.

* Help analyze and improve concurrency and throughput across the request and storage paths.

**Scalability & Data Movement**

* Contribute to the systems that move and tier data from high-performance NVMe through HDD to the tape cold-storage tier (ActiveScale Cold Storage).

**Engineering**

* Write clean, well-tested code with unit, component, and integration tests, use CI, take part in design discussions and code reviews, and grow toward independent ownership of components under the guidance of senior engineers.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 5 years of software development experience using Go, Python, C, C++, or Rust (or equivalent systems-level fundamentals), with a willingness to learn additional languages.

* Hands-on software development experience with concurrent, networked, distributed, or systems-level software.

* Solid Linux fundamentals, including basic debugging and performance analysis, with a willingness to develop deeper profiling and systems-debugging skills.

* Understanding of the basics of concurrency, locking, asynchronous programming, and memory management.

* Understanding of cloud or enterprise storage concepts and familiarity with storage technologies such as HDD, SSD, and NVMe, with an interest in learning about multi-tier storage systems.

* Good communication skills; ability to work in a team environment and with remote colleagues.

* Self-motivated and eager to learn, with a creative problem-solving mindset.

* This is a hybrid role, with in-office work at our Centennial, CO office Tuesday through Thursday.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with the Linux I/O subsystem and networking.

* Knowledge of erasure coding principles.

* Experience with object storage.

* Experience with storage protocols and with clustering design and development.

* Experience with APIs and communication protocols such as REST, gRPC, or Thrift.

* Familiarity with OCaml is welcome but not required; parts of the existing ActiveScale codebase are written in it.

* Experience with the Amazon S3 API, SDKs, and tools.

new_jobs.title: Mid level Agentic AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

You will design, build, and operate production-grade multi-agent systems for commercial and federal customers. The work spans the LangChain ecosystem, reliable agent loops, advanced retrieval architectures, and ontologies that ground agent reasoning.

You will also connect agents to enterprise tools and to each other through MCP and A2A. This role suits an engineer who thinks in systems: how agents reason, retrieve, act, recover from failure, and get evaluated and observed in production.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Agent development and orchestration

* Build single- and multi-agent applications with LangChain and LangGraph, including stateful graphs, supervisor/worker and hierarchical patterns, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Engineer robust agentic loops (plan, act, observe, reflect) with clear termination conditions, retry and self-correction logic, guardrails, and cost and latency budgets.
* Apply loop engineering to tune iteration depth, tool-call strategy, memory handling, and state persistence so agents behave predictably.
* Use LangSmith for tracing, debugging, prompt and dataset management, and automated evaluation; maintain regression suites for agent behavior.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

* Build and optimize Agentic RAG (agent-driven query planning and iterative retrieval), Adaptive RAG (routing by query complexity), Corrective and Self-RAG, GraphRAG (knowledge-graph retrieval and reasoning), and Cache-Augmented Generation with semantic caching.
* Design chunking, embedding, hybrid search, re-ranking, and query-rewriting strategies.
* Measure retrieval quality with faithfulness, context precision and recall, and answer relevance.

Ontologies, context, and skills

* Develop domain ontologies and knowledge graphs (OWL/RDF or property-graph models) that ground agent reasoning and power GraphRAG.
* Practice context engineering: decide how instructions, memory, retrieved knowledge, and tool results are assembled in the context window.
* Build reusable agent skills and tool libraries with clear interfaces, documentation, and versioning.

Interoperability protocols

* Build and integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients that expose enterprise data, APIs, and tools to agents securely.
* Implement Agent-to-Agent (A2A) patterns for agent discovery, capability negotiation, task delegation, and cross-vendor communication.

Engineering and delivery

* Write production-quality Python (TypeScript optional) with tests, CI/CD, and secure coding practices.
* Take agents from prototype to production with product, data, and platform teams.
* Contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, and internal standards for agentic systems.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10 years of software engineering, with at least 4 years building LLM-powered applications.
* Hands-on production experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith.
* Demonstrated experience designing agentic loops, tool calling, memory, and multi-agent orchestration.
* Practical experience implementing several RAG variants (Agentic, Adaptive, GraphRAG, Cache RAG/CAG) and evaluating their quality.
* Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs and applying them to retrieval or reasoning.
* Strong context engineering and prompt design for complex agent workflows.
* Experience building or integrating MCP servers and clients, and working knowledge of the A2A protocol.
* Proficiency in Python, REST/gRPC APIs, and asynchronous programming.
* Solid grasp of LLM failure modes (hallucination, prompt injection, context limits) and their mitigations.

Trillion is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered for positions without regard to race, religion, gender, native origin, age, disability, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

new_jobs.title: Founding Machine Learning Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About Onescreen**

Onescreen is the modern platform for out-of-home advertising — making it easier for brands and agencies to plan, buy, and measure OOH campaigns across thousands of vendors and formats. We move fast, operate lean, and hold ourselves to a high standard on every campaign we run.

**About the role**

You'll be the founding ML engineer who owns our matching algorithms from exploration through production and the data platform that feeds them. You'll design and ship the models that rank OOH inventory against advertiser personas, markets, and dayparts. You'll own our data warehouse shape and the pipelines that fill it. You'll publish the ranking and matching APIs that downstream products, agents, and automation surfaces consume.

**What you'll do**

* Design and ship matching and ranking models for OOH inventory: candidate generation, re-ranking, geospatial-aware scoring.
* Own the data warehouse layer end to end: staging, marts, feature pipelines, freshness, lineage.
* Stand up offline and online evaluation infrastructure — measure the gap between them, don't assume it.
* Publish ranking and matching APIs for product surfaces, with latency and quality SLOs.
* Instrument model monitoring: drift detection, prediction distribution, feature freshness, retraining triggers.

### **Qualifications**

**The hard requirement:** you have owned a production ranking, matching, or recommendation system end-to-end. You chose the model, designed the features, made the evaluation methodology calls, and were on the hook when it drifted. We care about that ownership scope more than years on a résumé — title and compensation are scaled to your demonstrated expertise.

Beyond that:

* Strong production Python (NumPy, Pandas, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy).
* Strong SQL and modern data warehouse experience (BigQuery preferred).
* Real ranking and matching modeling fluency — learning-to-rank, retrieval and re-rank patterns, not just classification.
* Evaluation methodology rigor: holdouts, leakage prevention, online vs. offline gap measurement.
* Comfort owning the data pipeline as well as the model.
* Bias toward shipping. Clear writer. Self-directed.

#### **Nice to have**

* Geospatial data experience (H3, PostGIS, GeoPandas)
* Mobility or location data experience
* Embedding-based retrieval (pgvector, FAISS, vector databases)
* Bandits, contextual bandits, or online learning
* A/B testing infrastructure design
* Causal inference
* dbt
* Ad-tech or OOH domain familiarity

This role supports data engineering initiatives for our data across ERP and MRP platforms, project management systems, field mobility tools, scheduling systems, financial systems, and construction technology solutions. The Data Engineer designs and maintains integrations and data pipelines that improve project visibility, reporting reliability, data availability, and digital transformation efforts across a capital-intensive construction environment.

The position plays a key role in strengthening data governance, improving data quality, automating data movement, and building scalable data infrastructure that enables enterprise growth and operational excellence through our data lake house.

**Success in the position is achieved through the following duties & responsibilities:**

* Construction Data Pipelines & Integration
* + Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines that support project managers, operations leaders, and executive reporting needs.
* + Integrate data from ERP/MRP, project management, scheduling, field mobility, and financial systems into governed enterprise datasets.
* + Develop and maintain transformations that standardize project, labor, cost, vendor, material, and operational data for downstream use.
* Technology & Systems Integration
* + Support data integration requirements for system implementations, upgrades, and digital transformation projects.

* Data Platform Engineering & Automation

* + Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot failures, and improve reliability, scalability, and data processing efficiency.
* + Document data flows, transformations, dependencies, and technical standards to support maintainable and reproducible solutions.

This role is critical to ensure enterprise technology investments and construction operations are supported by accurate, timely, and reliable data. The Data Engineer strengthens the integration between technology systems and field execution by building trusted data pipelines that enable reporting, forecasting, financial controls, and operational decision-making.

By improving integrations across enterprise systems, this role creates a scalable data foundation for predictable project delivery, capital efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Silverthorne Advisory Group is seeking a skilled and highly motivated Data Engineer to join an exciting and growing opportunity within the Defense sector. As a Data Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and maintaining our client's cloud and data infrastructure and systems. Your expertise in ETL, Databricks, Python, Spark, Scala, JavaScript/JSON, SQL, and Jupyter Notebooks will be essential in ensuring efficient data processing and analysis.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Design, develop, and implement end-to-end data pipelines, utilizing ETL processes and technologies such as Databricks, Python, Spark, Scala, JavaScript/JSON, SQL, and Jupyter Notebooks.
* Create and optimize data pipelines from scratch, ensuring scalability, reliability, and high-performance processing.
* Perform data cleansing, data integration, and data quality assurance activities to maintain the accuracy and integrity of large datasets.
* Leverage big data technologies to efficiently process and analyze large datasets, particularly those encountered in a federal agency.
* Troubleshoot data-related problems and provide innovative solutions to address complex data challenges.

Implement and enforce data governance policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  

* Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and design optimal data models and architectures.
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and stakeholders to provide timely and accurate data insights and support decision-making processes.
* Maintain documentation for software applications, workflows, and processes.
* Stay updated with emerging trends and advancements in data engineering and recommend suitable tools and technologies for continuous improvement.

,
  
Required Skills
  
  

* 3+ years of experience in the related field.
* U.S. citizenship with an active Secret clearance (we can sponsor).
* Strong SQL knowledge: Ability to write, troubleshoot, and modify complex SQL procedures and queries across a variety of datasets.
* Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) experience: Experience with establishing and maintaining data load processes as well as manipulating and combining various data sources.
* Business Intelligence experience: Creating and updating applications, reports, dashboards, etc. Cognos Analytics, Qlik Sense, and Power BI especially are relevant to the role.
* Python and Coding experience: Hands-on experience with languages/technologies such as Python, Spark, Scala, JavaScript/JSON, and SQL.

,
  
Desired Skills
  
  

* Databricks experience: Familiarity with Databricks, Amazon AWS/S3, Jupyter Notebooks will be helpful in the role.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to solve complex data-related issues.
* Demonstrated experience working with large datasets and leveraging big data technologies to process and analyze data efficiently.
* Understanding of data modeling/visualization, database design principles, and data governance practices.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Detail-oriented mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
* Teradata experience is a plus. Knowledge of Multiloads, BTEQs, and other assorted Teradata procedures will be helpful in the role.
* Accounting knowledge is a plus. Some background on DoD accounting system (DEAMS, TFMS, NERP etc.) and transportation policies will be helpful in the role.

,
  
Additional Details
  
  

* Compensation - We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, including but not limited to prior experience, skills, expertise, location, and other considerations permitted by law.
* Healthcare - We offer Health, Vision, and Dental Plans for our employees and their families.
* Retirement Plan – We invest in your future with a competitive 401(k) plan, where we match 100% of your contributions up to your first 6% and give you access to Vanguard Admiral funds.
* Paid Time Off - Based on length of service, we offer a generous amount of paid leave.
* Bonus System – As you invest in us, we invest in you. We offer bonuses to all employees who meet and exceed goals throughout the year.
* Professional Development – Support for career growth through training programs and certifications.
* Company Retreats & Team Events – Sponsored trips, team-building activities, and annual conferences related to your skillset.

,

We are a data, cloud engineering, management and IT consulting firm. We help our clients transform their businesses by leveraging innovative technology solutions to optimize business processes, scale technology, and drive data-driven decision-making.
  
  
What sets us apart? Expert talent, deep collaboration, and a relentless focus on impact. Our team - comprised of former industry leaders and top-tier consultants - combines big-firm expertise with the agility and client focus of a boutique firm. We listen first, tailor solutions to each client’s needs, and leave organizations stronger than when we arrived.

new_jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**nou Systems, Inc. (nSI) is a 100% employee-owned company!** We value teamwork and collaboration, and this transition allows us to take that commitment to a new level. nSI empowers our customers by supplying products, services, and expertise with powerful, data driven insights that transform defense systems and improve capabilities.

We are pleased to announce the opening for a Data Platforms Integrator (Engineer 4 / Analyst 4), who will support the Missile Defense Agency's (MDA) Next Generation Environment (NGE) program and become part of our technology company operating in missile defense, cybersecurity, test range modernization, biotechnology, and space control marketspaces. You will be part of a team known for delivering innovative technical solutions that support critical national security missions.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor in a Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA) capacity, directly supporting the Government Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and NGE leadership. You will provide technical oversight and integration guidance for the NGE Data Design Area, supporting the development of a secure, resilient hybrid multi-cloud environment.

You will evaluate existing applications, databases, and modern data platforms across AWS, Azure, and on-premises environments to ensure alignment with the Department of Defense (DoD) Zero Trust Strategy. Your work will focus on data discovery, classification, protection, and access governance to ensure mission-critical information remains secure and accessible only to authorized users.

**Responsibilities:**

You'll be responsible for:

* Serving as a senior technical authority in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), evaluating proposed database architectures, data storage solutions, and data pipelines against NGE requirements and DoD Zero Trust mandates.
* Conducting technical assessments of existing mission applications, relational databases, NoSQL environments, and object storage repositories to identify modernization opportunities and Zero Trust integration gaps.
* Providing architectural oversight for enterprise data discovery, automated cataloging, classification, labeling, and tagging across hybrid multi-cloud environments.
* Designing and validating data protection solutions, including data-at-rest encryption, automated Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data rights management, and dynamic data masking.
* Ensuring data platform architectures align with DISA Thunderdome Zero Trust capabilities, including Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), and enterprise DLP policies.
* Developing and evaluating fine-grained Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) solutions using Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) attributes and contextual risk assessments.
* Overseeing integration of Policy Enforcement Points (PEPs) and Policy Decision Points (PDPs) to support dynamic authorization and secure data access.
* Providing technical guidance for data virtualization, database security, and access governance across AWS, Azure, and on-premises VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) environments.
* Ensuring compliance with DoD Data-at-Rest (DAR) requirements, Key Management Service (KMS) integration standards, Hardware Security Module (HSM) requirements, and applicable JSIG and NIST SP 800-207 guidelines.
* Evaluating data platform modernization strategies and integration approaches to improve interoperability, security, and enterprise data governance.
* Leading technical exchange meetings (TEMs) with integration contractors, database vendors, and security technology providers to evaluate proposed solutions and resolve cross-platform integration challenges.
* Translating Government leadership requirements into actionable engineering solutions while maintaining alignment with NGE architecture and DoD cybersecurity standards.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* You must have a Master's degree in a STEM discipline with at least 12 years of engineering or IT architectural experience, or a Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline with at least 20 years of relevant experience. Degrees in Computer Science, Data Management, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline are preferred.
* You must have a minimum of 6 years of experience analyzing, architecting, and integrating complex enterprise databases, including relational database management systems (RDBMS), NoSQL platforms, storage solutions, and data pipelines.
* You must have demonstrated experience designing and implementing Zero Trust data protection solutions, including automated data classification, data rights management, dynamic access governance, and encryption.
* You must have hands-on experience architecting and securing enterprise data storage and analytics services across both AWS and Microsoft Azure environments.
* You must have experience designing, accrediting, and operating data platforms within classified DoD environments.
* You must possess an active Top Secret security clearance with current SCI eligibility (TS/SCI).
* You must meet DoD 8140/8570 requirements for an IAM Level III or IASAE Level II/III position.
* You must possess an active (ISC)² Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification.
* You must be a U.S. citizen to be eligible for this position.

Lacking any one of these disqualifies you from this job.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* AWS Certified Data Analytics – Specialty or AWS Certified Database – Specialty certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator (SC-400) certification.
* Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) certification.
* Experience implementing DISA Thunderdome Zero Trust capabilities and applying the DoD Data Strategy, DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture, and NIST SP 800-207.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DataOps automati
